# Item reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/items-doc.mjs (npm run docs:items). Do not edit by hand. -->

31 items. Cooldown is the base value at level 1. Every item declares its own per-level growth, in its effect text (see docs/design/effects-v2.md); nothing scales by default. Items reach level 5. The enchant column shows what each tier unlocks: the first enchant at level 3 and the extra enchant at level 5 (the evolved forms use the levels written in their texts). Common items evolve at level 5 into a form that levels up without limit, by rewards and kills; the form's rarity rises with its level (uncommon, rare at 10, epic at 15, legendary at 20). Element is the badge shown on the item icon.
